symbol: Workspace fixture/reference keys and display name
smell: Workspace and sibling workspace entities persist fixture/reference fields as broad S.String (`fixtureKey`, `organizationFixtureKey`, `ownerPrincipalFixtureKey`, `artifactFixtureKey`, `threadFixtureKey`, `scenarioFixtureKey`) and `Workspace.name` as broad S.String, while examples and tests use stable dotted non-empty keys plus a meaningful display name.
proposedTarget: Introduce named annotated schemas such as WorkspaceFixtureKey/WorkspaceReferenceKey backed at minimum by S.NonEmptyString (verified .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:8420), optionally with S.isPattern for dotted fixture ids (verified :6521), and use TrimmedNonEmptyText for `name` (packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/CommonTextSchemas.ts:36). In-package examples at WorkspaceDomain.test.ts:66-69 show the key grammar (`workspace.acme`, `org.acme`, `principal.owner`).

smell: `receivedAt` is S.String and `sourceSpans` is S.Array(S.String), even though the model describes a normalized imported email artifact with timestamp and source-span identifiers.
proposedTarget: Use an annotated timestamp schema such as ISOStr or ToIsoStr from packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/Timestamp/Timestamp.schema.ts:45 and :130 for `receivedAt`, and use S.Array(S.NonEmptyString) or NonEmptyArrayOfNonEmptyStrings (packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/ArrayOf.ts:86 and :115) for `sourceSpans` depending on whether imported artifacts may legitimately have no spans. Effect v4 S.NonEmptyArray is verified at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:4533.

smell: `TurnItems` is an unbounded S.Array(TurnItem), but all observed turn creation paths insert at least one message item and the schema prose says it is the ordered item list held by a turn aggregate.
proposedTarget: If empty turns are not a durable state, tighten to S.NonEmptyArray(TurnItem).pipe($I.annoteSchema("TurnItems", ...)); S.NonEmptyArray is verified in Effect v4 at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:4533. Keep S.Array only if remediation confirms a draft/in-progress empty-turn boundary, and ledger that exception explicitly.

smell: Reusable exported entity/value schemas carry whole-schema `$I.annote` / `$I.annoteSchema` metadata, but public fields such as Workspace.fixtureKey/name, EmailArtifact.receivedAt/sourceSpans, Turn.items/turnIndex, and candidate snapshot fields have no field-level `annotateKey` descriptions.
proposedTarget: Add behavior-neutral `.annotateKey({ description })` or `$I.annoteKey(...)` metadata to public fields while preserving current wire shape; follow packages/agents/server/src/AssistantTurn/BlockRepair.ts:62-64. Effect v4 `annotateKey` is verified at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:185 and :605.

proposedTarget: Add additive schema-law tests importing production schemas from @beep/workspace-domain and using assertSchemaArbitraryDecodesToSelf from @beep/test-utils (packages/tooling/test-kit/test-utils/src/Schema.ts:30-43) for ApprovalDecision, CandidateLifecycle, MessageRole, TurnItem, TurnItems, Workspace, Thread, Message, Turn, EmailArtifact, ContextPacket, ApprovalGate, CandidateDraft, CandidateProject, and CandidateTask after any precision tightening. smell: Detector candidate: imported email content/contact fields are broad (`body: S.String`, `subject: S.String`, `from: UnknownRecord`, `to: S.Array(UnknownRecord)`).
proposedTarget: None - keep these broad until a stable mail-contact contract is owned by this package.

exception.reason: Email body and subject are literal external content where empty strings can be valid, and contact payload shapes vary by importer/provider; tightening them in S5 would invent a mail-address contract outside the current workspace-domain ownership.
